Draft an offer

Editing a published offer returns it to draft. A fresh check is required.

Offers and checks

A merchant check confirms the retailer’s published offer. A checkout check confirms the code or price was accepted. Normal checks last 24 hours; glitches last four. Stale offers disappear until rechecked.

Report queue

Review the evidence, check the offer, then resolve the report. Reports do not change prices or badges automatically.

Email alerts

Brevo integration prepared. Sign-ups stay closed until sender verification and delivery tests pass.

Only confirmed subscribers can receive campaigns. Prepare an alert from the current checked feed, review the draft in Brevo, then send it there.
